notes.title: Update and a look back
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26881902/8f1d9f3bfd0c09e2014a1a161972dd51badbfdd3.png[/img]
Hello Squakers!

It's been a busy time since the release of the game. Lots of updates, changes, and improvements. And you all helped us make them.

We just released another update with some interesting and big changes that we bet you all will enjoy.
Here they are:
[list]
[*] Steam Cloud working across Win/Mac
[*] Freeze powerup now creates a frost wave that expands, no longer a whole map freeze
[*] Added word collecting mini-game! Now you will receive coins once you collect words in Arena maps. Definitely a challenge
[*] Greatly reduced inverse steering drops
[*] Bug Fix for when train wasn't following the mouse while a mouse button was pressed
[*] An error message is shown when trying to use incorrect control type (using keyboard when controller is plugged in for example)
[*] An icon on dominating player's name is shown Domination mode to help identify and hunt them down!
[/list]
So that's this update. Not an insignificant one, eh?
And most of the updates were like that. Let us look back at the changes and fixes since the release:
[list]
[*] Fixed buggy controls for when playing with a controller
[*] Active Powerup indication on the train, with indications before they end
[*] Hall Of Fame!
[*] Collisions with walls improved greatly across all levels (iterated many times)
[*] Fixed and improved indication of the Domination mode leader
[*] Button cooldown timers
[*] Joystick control mode when Follow is selected in Settings
[*] Controller support for navigating menus
[*] When player boosts, turning speed remains the same, but the radius of the turn is increased
[*] Added text notifications for team towers when teams reach 30%, 50% and 80% points.
[*] Fixed incorrect domination leader being shown.
[*] Fixed crash when exiting game on Windows.
[*] Fixed spawning on Saws
[*] 20% dead zone for joystick and triggers
[*] Some font adjustments
[*] Singapore server added
[*] MUSIC!
[*] Balance tweaks on many maps
[*] Cooldown timers for the switches
[*] Large improvements to how bouncing works
[*] Some glitchy quests and many other small issues are now fixed.
[/list]
Not a bad list, we'd think. And this is just since release, with lots of small tweaks that are not even on the list. The changes we've made since the beta launch has is huge!

So, now with all of this, we believe the game is at a point where it's much, much better and more fun.
Ever since the game has been approved on Greenlight in 2013, there was a sense of "this would be fun to play with more people". This feeling remained and was the driving force for the last year before the release.
Even though there was a big gap in development and a lot has changed since 2013, this has not, and when getting back to Squake we knew what needed to be done.
At this point, the original concept is so different to what the game is now, that it feels like it's almost Squake 2 that's been released.


[b]With all that said, there's another thing that we'd like to bring attention to.
The game is now way cheaper! [/b]

notes.title: Patch time!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26881902/83b1fdd47f9f3363414a6750de04e9d1b6b7bbdd.png[/img]
Choo-choo everyone!

A relatively small patch for today.

The list of changes is:
- Fixed buggy controls for when playing with a controller
- Now active Powerups are indicated on train, with indications before they end
- And the big one - Hall Of Fame! 

The Hall Of Fame is currently tracking two stats but we are considering expanding the list (with reason). If you have any suggestions - shoot!

That is pretty much it for this week. We are planning some interesting changes for the upcoming week, however. Stay tuned!

notes.title: New Patch! (we've really lost count at this point)
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26881902/83b1fdd47f9f3363414a6750de04e9d1b6b7bbdd.png[/img]
Squakers!

Some changes and fixes for the weekend.

As you may have already noticed, this week we've adjusted quite a few important things this week. Among these:
[list]
[*][b]Collisions with walls improved greatly across all levels[/b] - quite a big quality of life improvement and some of you have said so.
[*][b]Fixed and improved indication of Domination mode leader[/b] - so this one is a smaller one but important nonetheless.
[*][b]Added text notifications for Team Towers when teams reach certain progress points[/b] - similarly to the Domination leader tweaks, this one did improve the game in a small but significant way.
[*][b]Button cooldown timers[/b] - this did make matches less hectic, didn't it?
[*]Lots of fixes, tweaks... Oh, and [b]music![/b] Yes! Thanks again to [b]Maks_SF[/b]
[/list]

Quite a lot of changes happened this week. And they were important! 
Well, so are the ones for today:
[list]
[*][b]Added a new Joystick control mode when Follow is selected in Settings[/b] - This mode should give much better precision to all of you playing with a controller. Try it out, let us know what you think.
[*][b]Added controller support for navigating menus[/b] - pretty self explanatory, really. As always, give us feedback on this :)
[*][b]When player boosts, turning speed remains the same, but the radius of the turn is increased[/b] - The train used to become hardly controllable after boosting before and this change fixes that issue. It should be smooth throughout.
[*][b]Korean localisation[/b]
[/list]

Now, as usual, feedback is much appreciated, so leave your comments about all of this week's changes!

See you on the field!

notes.title: Small update!
notes.content:
Dear Friends,

We've just pushed a small update.

- You'll no longer spawn on Saws
- Joystick and triggers now have 20% dead zone
- A bit better collision boxes on all of the maps (more to come in next 1-2 days)
- Some font adjustments
- Singapore server added

In 1-2 days we are going to finish and push a big improvement to our collision/bounce/scrapping system (you'll die less often) :)

Please stay tuned!

Choo-Choo!!!

notes.title: New stuff!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26881902/83b1fdd47f9f3363414a6750de04e9d1b6b7bbdd.png[/img]

[b]Dear Friends,.. SQUAKE is evolving![/b]

Time to get back to the battle and check out all the new stuff we added to the game:

 - [b]MUSIC[/b]! Yeah, now we got music!
Big thanks to Maks_SF, he composed the track.
Please let us know what do you think about it. 

 - [b]Balance[/b] tweaks on many maps!

 - [b]Cooldown timers[/b] for the switches. Now you can't turn them on/off repeatedly any more. Even buttons need some rest.

 - [b]Controls[/b]: They just got better. Large improvements to how bouncing works. Scratching something very lightly will kill you way less likely!

- Some glitchy quests and many other small issues are now fixed.

- More stuff coming soon.

See you on the field!
[b]Yeah, literally, do launch the game right now and play it![/b]

notes.title: SQUAKE is out!
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Friends,[/h1]

It finally happened. [b]SQUAKE is fully out on Steam![/b]

It's been a long journey for us, which started back in 2013 when we completed Steam Greenlight with your help. And it still continues!

[b]Thanks a lot to all of you for your support and feedback![/b]

Speaking about SQUAKE itself, the new version we launched yesterday as you could see, contains lots of new stuff.

First, it's the "[b]Squake Land[/b]": the main game map where you can unlock new islands (locations) and upgrade them by completing cup-quests.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26881902/a7d8b9d52cec2c78512df3381478f4bc396dac2b.png[/img]


The second thing is [b]new maps[/b]. We've added:
- Fire Pit (Domination)
- Neon Blasters (Team Towers)
- Emergency Shelter (Domination)
- Hex Arena (well, it's an Arena)
- Gun Range (Domination)

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26881902/a9c7a5b1c675c127a7f2f0155cffc70c27dc281c.png[/img]

Also we've done a few [b]smaller things[/b]:
- added a short tutorial
- changed the default controls to mouse
- fixed some crashes
- improved small things here and there.

In parallel, we are always working on improving the [b]balance[/b]. Your feedback here is very welcome: if you have any ideas on how to improve things, please let us know!

And the last thing: all [b]Squake pioneers[/b] got a fancy skull near their names!

We hope you'll love these changes.

[b]More to come![/b]

[h1]CHOO CHOO TO GLORY!!![/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26881902/62f314483881fb162b2e084462cc46ac2d566aeb.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch #8... We think?
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26881902/d9bf4ec970d7c65ceaeae89ac27f8fe3f72d9dd5.png[/img]

Hey squakers!

A rather big update has been pushed today.
Some fixes, adjustments and such, but most importantly:
- Capture The Flag mode. 
- Chat within game rooms. It sends and receives messages. Revolutionary! No, really, it's nothing too fancy, but it is there for you to enjoy. Just press that big "Enter".

CTF is currently available on one map only (Space Point), but it wont stay like for long. Adjustment to other maps, along with new ones, are coming. It might have, ghem, issues so we hope you will let us know about them. Fixes will be made quickly!

A thing to note also, is that you can change your control method between keyboard or mouse follow in the About section.


There will be more soon, but in the meantime...

See you on the field!

notes.content:

notes.title: First Squake Patch for 2017
notes.content:
Hello squakers!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26881902/d9bf4ec970d7c65ceaeae89ac27f8fe3f72d9dd5.png[/img]
We've been working on some changes in gameplay and wanted to push this out for you to check!

So we have...
- Added mouse follow control mode. It can be enabled in 'About' tab in main menu.
- Game Controller: left and right triggers now turn the train
- Reworked main menu tabs logic. They behave more naturally
- Domination timer is now 1-10 instead of previously 0-9
- Domination: current longest train is marked with a cup on the right side scoreboard.
- Team Towers: shows numbers in top-center of the screen when somebody brings dynamites.
- Fixed quest slide out, it doesn't hide when mouse is on the edge of screen

As you can see, some changes are minor and others have a bit of a bigger impact on gameplay.

Next update will have a new map for you to drive around in. Monday?...

See you on the field!

notes.title: Squake Patch 2
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26881902/d9bf4ec970d7c65ceaeae89ac27f8fe3f72d9dd5.png[/img]
And we have another one!

Here's today's list of changes and fixes:
- Fixed coin reward not working on Bunkers
- Fixed bounce. Rotation is briefly turned off (0.1s) after bounce
- Fixed loading screen being shown in some cases when its not supposed to be
- Fixed a visual bug when final scoreboard had player list too low in battle tag in some cases
- Adjusted how other player trains are shown - this should make collisions with other train more accurate

More to come next week!

notes.title: First update for the closed launch
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26881902/d9bf4ec970d7c65ceaeae89ac27f8fe3f72d9dd5.png[/img]
Here are the first things we have fixed:
- Saw is no longer 10 seconds by default
- Correct values should now be shown for coins shown in final scoreboard
- Scoreboard should no longer display wrong information after playing both on Domination and Team Towers modes
- Steam names should be displayed correctly on the final scoreboard
- Cup placement should now update on the map
- Quest should now reward coins properly
- Showing the coin icon near the Claim button
- ERR_FMT place number in leaderboard should no longer be shown
- Fixed player team assignment for the Team Tower game mode
- Rooms should fill with 8 players

We will be updating the game as often as possible with fixes so be sure to check it out and let us know about your experience.
